title: Graetz problem with plug flow and axial conduction (analytic)
description:
Laminar flow + heat (fluid_heat_convection), stationary: a liquid enters a channel at T_in with a uniform (plug) velocity U (slip walls, velocity inlet x_lo, pressure 0 at x_hi) and is cooled by walls held at T_w (y faces); heat conducts along and across the channel.
Analytic (separation of variables, semi-infinite channel): T = T_w + (T_in - T_w) (4/pi) sum_odd n sin(n pi y / H) exp(-lam_n x) / n, lam_n = (sqrt(Pe^2 + 4 n^2 pi^2) - Pe) / (2H), Pe = U H / a, a = k / (rho cp); bulk mean theta_b(x) = (8/pi^2) sum_odd n exp(-lam_n x) / n^2.
Line profile tab: T_centreline (T along y = H/2) and T_across (T across the channel at x = H), 9 terms (the series is slow only within ~0.1 H of the inlet corners); u_plug checks the plug flow u_x = U; the flow starts there (initial_velocity), a fixed point of correct face rules, so each steady march stops after a few checks instead of ~280k lattice steps from rest, while wrong face rules would move it. They show the last sweep value, the base Pe = 4.
Derived values tab: theta_probe (centreline at x = H) and theta_bulk (mean over the cell column at x = H) against the series.
Sweep tab: theta_probe and theta_bulk versus Pe (1..6) with the dashed series.
Expected agreement ~0.5 % (theta_bulk ~0.6 %; relative to each curve's range: T_centreline ~0.1 %, T_across ~0.5 %) (second-order central advection, the inlet corner, the insulated outlet at L = 5H where theta ~ 1e-3 at most). The coupled solve is a relaxed Picard loop (study relaxation 0.6, gain ~ Pe / (2 pi)); it slows above Pe ~ 6.

parameters.name: Pe
parameters.description: Peclet number U H / a of the channel; swept

parameters.name: mu_f
parameters.description: dynamic viscosity of the liquid in Pa s

parameters.name: rho_f
parameters.description: liquid density in kg/m^3

parameters.name: k_f
parameters.description: liquid thermal conductivity in W/(m K)

parameters.name: cp_f
parameters.description: liquid specific heat in J/(kg K)

parameters.name: a_f
parameters.description: thermal diffusivity in m^2/s (1.5e-7)

parameters.name: dx_cell
parameters.description: uniform square cell size

parameters.name: H_ch
parameters.description: channel height along y

parameters.name: L_ch
parameters.description: channel length along x (long enough to stand for a semi-infinite channel)

parameters.name: U_in
parameters.description: plug velocity in m/s (0.03 at Pe = 4; Reynolds ~0.6, cell Peclet Pe dx / H = 0.2)

parameters.name: T_in
parameters.description: inflow temperature in K (held on x_lo)

parameters.name: T_w
parameters.description: wall temperature in K (held on y_lo and y_hi)

parameters.name: x_p
parameters.description: x of the probe and of the bulk column: a cell centre one channel height downstream

parameters.name: y_p
parameters.description: y of the probe: the cell centre just above the centreline

parameters.name: lam_1
parameters.description: decay rate of mode n = 1 in 1/m

parameters.name: lam_3
parameters.description: decay rate of mode n = 3 in 1/m

parameters.name: lam_5
parameters.description: decay rate of mode n = 5 in 1/m

parameters.name: lam_7
parameters.description: decay rate of mode n = 7 in 1/m

parameters.name: lam_9
parameters.description: decay rate of mode n = 9 in 1/m

parameters.name: lam_11
parameters.description: decay rate of mode n = 11 in 1/m

parameters.name: lam_13
parameters.description: decay rate of mode n = 13 in 1/m

parameters.name: lam_15
parameters.description: decay rate of mode n = 15 in 1/m

parameters.name: lam_17
parameters.description: decay rate of mode n = 17 in 1/m

parameters.name: theta_probe_ref
parameters.description: analytic (T - T_w) / (T_in - T_w) at the probe

parameters.name: theta_bulk_ref
parameters.description: analytic bulk (cross-section mean) dimensionless temperature at x_p

analytic_curves.name: T_centreline
analytic_curves.expression: T_w + (T_in - T_w)*4/pi*(sin(pi*y/H_ch)*exp(-lam_1*x) + sin(3*pi*y/H_ch)*exp(-lam_3*x)/3 + sin(5*pi*y/H_ch)*exp(-lam_5*x)/5 + sin(7*pi*y/H_ch)*exp(-lam_7*x)/7 + sin(9*pi*y/H_ch)*exp(-lam_9*x)/9 + sin(11*pi*y/H_ch)*exp(-lam_11*x)/11 + sin(13*pi*y/H_ch)*exp(-lam_13*x)/13 + sin(15*pi*y/H_ch)*exp(-lam_15*x)/15 + sin(17*pi*y/H_ch)*exp(-lam_17*x)/17)

analytic_curves.name: T_across
analytic_curves.expression: T_w + (T_in - T_w)*4/pi*(sin(pi*y/H_ch)*exp(-lam_1*x) + sin(3*pi*y/H_ch)*exp(-lam_3*x)/3 + sin(5*pi*y/H_ch)*exp(-lam_5*x)/5 + sin(7*pi*y/H_ch)*exp(-lam_7*x)/7 + sin(9*pi*y/H_ch)*exp(-lam_9*x)/9 + sin(11*pi*y/H_ch)*exp(-lam_11*x)/11 + sin(13*pi*y/H_ch)*exp(-lam_13*x)/13 + sin(15*pi*y/H_ch)*exp(-lam_15*x)/15 + sin(17*pi*y/H_ch)*exp(-lam_17*x)/17)
